esg.bulk.PackageManager

Defines the package of ESG data to retrieve bulk feeds from the Data Platform.

Available as lseg.data.content.esg.bulk.PackageManager.

Syntax

PackageManager(package_name, session=None) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
package_name Yes Name of the ESG data package to manage.
session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Methods
